name: list_legal_entities
description: List the club's legal entities (id, code, name, base currency).

name: list_venues
description: List the club's venues (racecourses and sites) with their legal entity and time zone.

name: search_parties
description: Search the shared party register (people and organisations: owners, trainers, jockeys, suppliers, members, customers) by name, external reference or email. Returns ids, contact details and addresses.

name: get_party
description: Full details of one party by id, including all addresses.

name: club_calendar
description: Open / closed days of a venue for one month (with notes).

name: reference_values
description: The allowed values of a reference-data domain, e.g. COUNTRY, CURRENCY, TAX_CODE, HORSE_BREED, UOM, ITEM_CATEGORY_CLASS, RACE_OFFICIAL_ROLE.

name: party_change_history
description: Audit trail of a party: who changed its details or any of its addresses, when, and the before / after value of every changed field. Use for questions like 'who changed X's address last week'. Accepts a party name or id; when several parties match the name, the candidates are returned so you can ask which one.

name: audit_events
description: Search the ERP-wide audit trail (every insert / update / delete on audited tables), newest first. Filter by database schema (e.g. enterprise_core, financial_ap, horse_registry), table, record id, actor (Keycloak username) and date range.

name: gl_accounts
description: Chart of accounts of a legal entity (code, name, type, posting flag). Optional text filter.

name: trial_balance
description: Trial balance (debits, credits and balance per account) for a date range from posted journals.

name: get_journal
description: One GL journal with its lines, by journal id.

name: search_horses
description: Search registered horses by name or registration number.

name: get_horse
description: Full horse record by id: pedigree, colour, breed, documents, medical summary, current owners.

name: horse_ownership
description: Owners of a horse and their percentage shares on a date (default today).

name: horse_eligibility
description: Whether a horse may race on a date, and the reasons if not.

name: list_licences
description: Racing licences (jockey, trainer, owner, official) with holder, number, validity and status.

name: check_licence
description: Is a party's licence of a type valid on a date (default today)?

name: horse_trainer
description: The trainer assigned to a horse on a date (default today).

name: participant_profile
description: Racing profile of a party: licences, jockey contracts, horses in training.

name: find_meetings
description: Race meetings between two dates (inclusive) with venue and status.

name: race_card
description: The race card: every race of a meeting with start time, distance, surface, purse, runners (saddlecloth, draw, horse, jockey, trainer, weight) and officials. Give the meeting date (resolve words like 'Saturday' to a date first) or a meeting id; with neither, the next meeting from today is used.

name: get_race
description: One race by id: details, runners, officials and results if run.

name: race_results
description: Finishing order of a race, finish times, disqualifications and whether the result is official.

name: race_pools
description: Tote pools of a race: bet type, takeout, total staked, status and declared dividends.

name: winning_tickets
description: Winning tickets of a race with dividend and paid status.

name: get_ticket
description: One wagering ticket by id: selections, stake, channel, status.

name: prize_schedule
description: Prize money split by finishing position for a race.

name: race_awards
description: Prize awards of a race: horse, payee (owner / trainer / jockey), amount, status.

name: party_awards
description: All prize awards paid or payable to a party (owner, trainer or jockey).

name: ticket_payout
description: Payout of a winning ticket: gross, tax withheld, net, status.

name: membership_plans
description: Membership plans with annual fee and guest allowance.

name: search_members
description: Search club members by name, member number or email.

name: member_details
description: One member with dependents and renewal history.

name: member_standing
description: Whether a member (by member id, or a member's or dependent's party id) is in good standing, with the reasons if not.

name: hospitality_outlets
description: Restaurants, bars and function rooms with capacity.

name: outlet_menu
description: Menu of an outlet with prices and tax codes.

name: table_reservations
description: Table reservations on a day (default today).

name: club_events
description: Upcoming club events with capacity, places booked, places left and price.

name: find_items
description: Stock items (SKU, description, category, unit, standard cost, reorder point). Optional text filter.

name: stock_locations
description: Stores and stock locations by venue.

name: stock_on_hand
description: Quantity and value on hand by item and location. Filter by item text and / or location code.

name: items_below_reorder
description: Items at or below their reorder point (stock across all locations) with the suggested order quantity.

name: list_suppliers
description: Suppliers with code, payment terms, tax id and status. Optional text filter.

name: purchase_orders
description: Purchase orders (newest first) with supplier, total, status and lines.

name: get_purchase_order
description: One purchase order with its lines, by id.

name: get_goods_receipt
description: One goods receipt with accepted / rejected quantities, by id.

name: ap_invoices
description: Supplier invoices (newest first, up to 200) with balance and status. Filter by status and supplier text.

name: outstanding_payables
description: What the club owes suppliers: open (approved, posted or part-paid) supplier invoices with a balance, totals by currency and days overdue, optionally for one supplier. Draft invoices not yet approved are listed separately.

name: get_ap_invoice
description: One supplier invoice with lines and payments, by id.

name: ap_ageing
description: Accounts payable ageing buckets on a date, reconciled to GL account 2100.

name: ar_invoices
description: Customer invoices (stabling, fees, member charges...) with balance and status. Filter by status, customer text and source module (e.g. MEMBERSHIP, HOSPITALITY, RACING).

name: customer_balance
description: What a customer owes the club: open invoices and total, by customer name or party id.

name: get_ar_invoice
description: One customer invoice with lines and receipts, by id.

name: ar_ageing
description: Accounts receivable ageing buckets on a date, reconciled to GL accounts 1200 / 1210.

name: cash_position
description: Book balance of every bank account, last statement date and closing balance, unmatched lines.

name: bank_transactions
description: Imported bank statement lines of a bank account (use cash_position for account ids).
